newsitem.title: USA: Great Western says early meeting backed.
newsitem.headline: Great Western says early meeting backed.

text.p: Great Western Financial Corp on Monday said an independent inspector certified a recount showing that H.F. Ahmanson & Co had received sufficient unrevoked shareholder consents in favor of Great Western holding its annual meeting by May 6.
The inspector, CT Corporation Systems, certified that Ahmanson had sufficient consents as of April 9.
Great Western has scheduled its annual meeting for June 13.
A source familiar with the situation said it was unclear what would happen next, though it would not be possible to organize a meeting on just one day's notice.
Ahmanson is seeking to acquire Great Western, which has agreed to merge with Washington Mutual Inc.

Great Western said preliminary results from the inspector showed Ahmanson received a majority for a proposed bylaw amendment concerning the quorum at the meeting and for another proposal on further amendments to the bylaws.
Great Western said the results on those two proposals were subject to further review and challenge.
